subject: Term shielding & scale commitment — MerchantLabs renewal
messages:
From: Anita Gomez <anita@merchantlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jae Park <jae.park@merchantlabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T13:22:00Z
Subject: MerchantLabs renewal — pricing & perf push from competitor

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick responses during our renewal window planning. We received a formal proposal from SolsticeAI that includes a significant price reduction and promises identical latency at scale. Procurement wants a performance demonstration and a commercial lever that protects us from price-driven churn.

Can Redwood provide: 
- a short benchmark report comparing p50/p95 token latency at 4k and 8k contexts for our workload profile,
- a capacity commitment/term that keeps us insulated from swaps by smaller bids, and
- any one-pager that explains what would change operationally (dedicated pool, pre-warm, rollback paths).

We'd like this material before the procurement review next Thursday (05/18). If you can share a draft MAP or PO-ready language, that would help speed sign-off.

Best,
Anita Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships, MerchantLabs
attachments: competitor-testlog.csv (provided)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Anita Gomez <anita@merchantlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MerchantLabs renewal — pricing & perf push from competitor

Anita —

Thanks for the heads up. We take renewal risk seriously and we can move quickly here. Proposed approach:

1) Ben (field eng) runs a focused benchmark against your representative prompt set at 4k/8k. I asked for a reproducible runbook and raw logs.
2) Monica pulls a term/commit play (12 vs 24 month) with dedicated pool pricing + fallback throughput SLAs.
3) We prepare a short MAP and a PO-ready clause that protects you from competitor-induced churn (performance-based termination window or credit ladder).

Ben / Monica — please prioritize. Anita — can you share the production prompt set (or a masked subset) and an API key with read-only sampling access? If you want, let's lock a slot for a 30-min sync Tuesday morning (05/16) to review the results.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anita Gomez <anita@merchantlabs.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T09:10:00Z
Subject: Benchmark plan + capacity offer (draft)

Anita / Hannah —

Attached is the runbook I executed today and an initial capacity offer draft. Summary highlights:

- Test matrix: 4k/8k context windows; 10k total tokens per scenario; 100 concurrent simulated sessions to mirror MerchantLabs traffic pattern.
- Execution: 3 runs per matrix cell, collected p50/p95/p99 latency and token cost.
- Environment: dedicated test pool (same GPU family we use in Production), KV cache warm-up for prefix-heavy flows.

Preliminary numbers (median across runs):
- 4k context: p50 42ms, p95 190ms; throughput 95 reqs/s
- 8k context: p50 78ms, p95 340ms; throughput 48 reqs/s

Commercial draft (attached):
- Option A: 12-month commit for 200k requests/day, dedicated pool, 15% discount to list.
- Option B: 24-month commit for 200k requests/day + autoscale burst, dedicated pool, 20% discount + 2 guaranteed maintenance windows per year.
- Performance protection: 30-day remediation credits if p95 exceeds committed target for >72h (rolling).

Attachments: benchmark-runbook.md, capacity-offer-ML-2028.pdf

Next steps: I can finish the full PDF benchmark report if you confirm the prompt set and we can schedule the sync for Tue 05/16 10:00am PT.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Field Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anita Gomez <anita@merchantlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jae Park <jae.park@merchantlabs.com>, procurement@merchantlabs.com
Date: 2028-05-16T08:34:00Z
Subject: Re: Benchmark plan + capacity offer (draft)

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I've attached the masked production prompt set and the competitor test log you asked for (competitor-testlog.csv). A few notes from our internal bench: SolsticeAI matched p50 but their p95 at 8k is spikier under real load. Procurement will want a guarantee that sudden spikes won't impact our checkout pages.

We can confirm Tue 10:00am PT. Procurement also asked for the explicit PO language you referenced (performance-credit ladder) in the PDF. Can Monica include the typical billing/legal wording?

-Anita

attachments: competitor-testlog.csv
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Anita Gomez <anita@merchantlabs.com>, procurement@merchantlabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-16T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Benchmark plan + capacity offer (draft) — bench results & MAP

Anita / Jae / Procurement —

Attached: bench-results-20280516.pdf (executive summary + raw logs), capacity-offer-ML-2028.pdf, and a shared MAP link. Key takeaways: 

- We re-ran the 8k profile with a target traffic spike (simulated checkout surge). Results: p95 held at 360ms peak during a 60s sustained spike; remediation steps executed automatically (KV-cache priming + short-lived dedicated warm nodes).
- Proposed contract language: 20% credit if p95 exceeds committed target for >72h cumulatively in a 30-day window; 10% credit for 24–72h. Full clause in capacity-offer-ML-2028.pdf.
- Commercial: 12-month commitment with dedicated pool + 20% discount for immediate signature. Offer valid until 2028-05-24.

I dropped a DocuSign link in the MAP doc for quick acceptance. If procurement is ready, Monica will shepherd the PO language and payment terms.

Onwards —
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
attachments: bench-results-20280516.pdf, capacity-offer-ML-2028.pdf
From: procurement@merchantlabs.com <procurement@merchantlabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Gomez <anita@merchantlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Term shielding & scale commitment — PO attached

Hannah / Monica —

We reviewed the bench report and the commercial terms with the finance committee. MerchantLabs will accept the 12-month dedicated-pool commitment at the 20% discount. Attached is the signed PO (PO_MerchantLabs_20280517.pdf).

Next steps: please confirm the kickoff date for onboarding and the technical contact for capacity handoff. We request a 2-week ramp plan and access to the dedicated pool by 2028-06-01.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
MerchantLabs
attachments: PO_MerchantLabs_20280517.pdf
